## Miauterm 0.1.6-coral

This release fixes terminal search behavior during live output, preserves wide characters when the terminal is resized, and makes the extra-keys bar a more compact 40 dp per row.

### Fixes and changes

- Preserve the selected search result while new terminal output arrives; run search and URL scans away from the UI thread.
- Keep wide CJK characters and emoji intact when terminal rows reflow after a resize.
- Prevent deleted lines from being copied into terminal scrollback.
- Serialize Debian backup restore with rootfs installation and run optional package provisioning only after the extracted rootfs has moved into its final location.
- Make first-run setup cancellation cooperative and avoid holding an Activity through the rootfs installation worker.
- Release terminal callbacks when views detach, report foreground-service startup failures, and defer PTY descriptor closure until the child process has been reaped.
- Improve accessibility touch targets and dialog button contrast.
- Keep the extra-keys bar at a medium size: 40 dp per row, with horizontal scrolling for wider custom layouts.
- Remove the obsolete Debian deletion state; the supported settings action resets the bundled Debian system.
- Validate release tags against the checked-out commit and run lint for the terminal engine module as well as the app.
- Correct bundled third-party notices and the security-reporting link.

This remains an experimental Android application. See the project README for the runtime model and PRoot compatibility limits.
